name: Resin
body:
School conjuration [wood]; Level druid 3, shaman 3, witch 3

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a bit of wood resin)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistances yes

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You conjure a globule of wood resin that you toss at an enemy within range as a ranged touch attack. On a hit, the target is staggered for the duration. Additionally, the resin reduces their ability to defend themselves by slowing their movements and rendering their existing armor ineffective. They take a penalty to AC 1/4 your caster level (minimum +1). An affected creature can attempt Strength check against the spell’s save DC to break free from the resin.
